name: Interaction states
purpose: One neutral, quiet vocabulary for focus, hover, selection, pressed, disabled and active navigation across every control.
whenToUse: Styling any interactive element: buttons, rows, inputs, nav items, tabs, menu items.
Showing a selected row, card or list item.
Indicating the current page in navigation.
Reviewing a component for P15 and P17 compliance.
whenNotToUse: Emerald focus rings, emerald selected rows or emerald input outlines (P15).
Thick or high-contrast outlines (2px and above, white outlines) for ordinary selection or focus (P17).
A frame, border or left bar to show selection. Selection is a quiet fill.
Removing the focus indicator (outline: none) without an equally visible replacement.
Distinct bespoke hover colours per component. Reuse the surface steps.
anatomy: Focus: keyboard-only :focus-visible ring, 1.5px solid --focus, offset 1px. Text inputs use a 1px --focus box-shadow ring instead.
Hover: one surface step lighter (--s2 on rows, --s3 to --s4 on buttons, rgba white 0.08 on menu items).
Selected: --select, a quiet fill. Strong selection (drag, active range): --select-strong.
Pressed: one step beyond hover (--s3 on rows, #444545 on secondary buttons).
Disabled: opacity 0.45 and no hover response.
Active navigation: --s3 background and --text colour with aria-current.

variants.description: Surface step lighter than the resting state.
variants.useWhen: Pointer over buttons, rows, menu items, nav items.

variants.description: --select fill on the row or card, no border.
variants.useWhen: Selected list items, cards, table rows.
Mouse down or touch on buttons and rows.
The current page or section in navigation.

behavior: Use :focus-visible so the ring shows for keyboard users and not for mouse clicks.

Focus ring contrast: --focus (rgba 236,236,235 at 0.5) resolves to about 4.7:1 on --s0, 4.6:1 on --s1, 4.4:1 on --s2, 4.1:1 on --s3 and 3.8:1 on --s4 (measured), all above the 3:1 minimum required by P17.
Menu items and options show focus as the hover fill, because the whole list shows one active item.
Selected and focused can coexist: selected fill plus the ring.
Hover on touch devices is not required; rely on the pressed state.
Use aria-selected, aria-current, aria-pressed, aria-disabled or disabled so assistive technology receives the same state.
accessibility: The focus indicator must reach at least 3:1 against the surface it sits on (WCAG 1.4.11). Verify the ring on --s0 to --s4 before introducing a new surface.
Do not confuse invisible focus with tasteful minimalism: P17 asks for restrained, not absent.
State is exposed with ARIA, not only visual: aria-selected, aria-current, aria-disabled.
Hover alone never reveals essential information or controls; reveal on focus as well.
Targets are at least 28px (32px for controls) to ease pointing.
